title: Satori business app action
description: Adds an action to actions.json: a lifecycle transition or an allowed Automation operation, on the record page, a queue's rows or its selection, with its texts in labels/en.json. Not a security control: Nuxeo still gates every operation and transition.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

id.description: The action's id, the package's own: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', not starting with 'app.' or 'core.'. Best begun with the app's id.

label.description: The button's text in English. Defaults to the id's last part, humanized.

transition.description: The lifecycle transition it follows. Give this or operation.

operation.description: The Automation operation or chain it runs, which must be on the deployment's allow-list. Give this or transition.

parameters.description: The operation's parameters, as a JSON object: each name to a literal, or to { "field": "<prefix>:<name>" } on a record or a row.

on.description: Where it shows, separated by commas: record (the record page's toolbar), row (a queue's row menu), bulk (a queue's selection). Defaults to record.

type.description: Show it only on records of this document type (app.rules.isType). Not with bulk, where there is no one record to read.

icon.description: A Material Symbols name, such as check.

confirm.description: A question, in English, asked before it runs.

success.description: A message, in English, shown after it ran.

queue.description: A queue of the package to offer it on: added to its rowActions when it shows on rows, and its bulkActions in bulk.

force.description: Replace the action if actions.json has its id already. Its labels keep the text labels/en.json has.
